notes.title: Megamelon DEMO 0.8.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45547958/500ff2c34e1042fe2ec382ce55c6291af84614ae.jpg[/img]

Demo 0.8.0 has been released and includes a lot of polish and an extra guest to play.

That makes two playable characters you can play and strip nude without paying a cent.
Play it now.

Sadly, I have had to push the release date back a little.

I had hoped to release the game on 9 May 2025, but I just won't be able to finish the game by then.

The game is listed as Coming Soon while I add the final touches.

Until next time, bartender.
